name: GHGForcing
description:
Calculates effective radiative forcing (ERF) from the well-mixed greenhouse
gases CO2, CH4 and N2O, following MAGICC7's forcing methods.

# What This Component Does

1. Calculates instantaneous radiative forcing from CO2, CH4 and N2O
   concentrations using either the IPCCTAR or the OLBL method
2. Accounts for CH4-N2O absorption band overlap
3. Applies rapid adjustment factors to convert to effective radiative forcing
4. Reports the 2xCO2 ERF and the ERF of stratospheric H2O from CH4 oxidation

# Methods

## IPCCTAR (Myhre et al. 1998)

Simple analytical formulae: logarithmic for CO2, square-root for CH4/N2O,
with overlap correction.

$$F_{CO2} = \frac{\Delta Q_{2 \times CO2}}{\ln 2} \cdot \ln\left(\frac{C}{C_0}\right)$$

The CH4-N2O overlap is

$$f(M, N) = 0.47 \cdot \ln\left(1 + 2.01 \times 10^{-5} (MN)^{0.75}
    + 5.31 \times 10^{-15} M (MN)^{1.52}\right)$$

## Oslo line-by-line (OLBL)

Meinshausen et al. (2020), shared with FaIR in [`rscm_components::meinshausen2020`],
with MAGICC7's coefficients and the pre-industrial concentrations as reference.
For CO2:

$$\alpha = a_1 (\Delta C)^2 + b_1 \Delta C + d_1 + c_1 \sqrt{N_2O}$$
$$F_{CO2} = \alpha \cdot \ln(C / C_0)$$

outputs.name: 2xCO2 Effective Radiative Forcing
outputs.description: 2xCO2 ERF, recalculated from the current CO2 and N2O with OLBL and fixed by `erf_2xco2` with IPCCTAR

outputs.name: Effective Radiative Forcing|CH4 Oxidation Stratospheric H2O
outputs.description: ERF of stratospheric H2O from CH4 oxidation, a fixed fraction of the CH4 ERF taken at pre-industrial N2O with OLBL and without the N2O overlap with IPCCTAR

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Forcing method (MAGICC7 `CORE_CO2CH4N2O_RFMETHOD`)

parameters.name: co2_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial CO2 concentration (MAGICC7 `CO2_PREINDCO2CONC`)

unit: ppm

Default: 278.0 ppm
MAGICC7: CO2_PREINDCO2CONC

parameters.name: ch4_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial CH4 concentration

unit: ppb

Default: 722.0 ppb

parameters.name: n2o_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial N2O concentration

unit: ppb

Default: 270.0 ppb

parameters.name: erf_2xco2
parameters.description:
2xCO2 effective radiative forcing (MAGICC7 `CORE_DELQ2XCO2`).

unit: W/m^2

The IPCCTAR method uses `alpha = erf_2xco2 / ln(2)`.

Default: 3.71 W/m2
MAGICC7: CORE_DELQ2XCO2

parameters.name: ch4_radiative_efficiency
parameters.description:
CH4 radiative efficiency, the IPCCTAR coefficient for CH4 (MAGICC7 `CH4_RADEFF_WM2PERPPB`)

unit: W/m^2 per sqrt(ppb)

Default: 0.036

parameters.name: n2o_radiative_efficiency
parameters.description:
N2O radiative efficiency, the IPCCTAR coefficient for N2O (MAGICC7 `N2O_RADEFF_WM2PERPPB`)

unit: W/m^2 per sqrt(ppb)

Default: 0.12

parameters.name: olbl_co2_a1
parameters.description:
OLBL CO2 quadratic coefficient $a_1$

unit: W/m^2/ppm^2

Default: -2.4785e-7

parameters.name: olbl_co2_b1
parameters.description:
OLBL CO2 linear coefficient $b_1$

unit: W/m^2/ppm

Default: 7.5906e-4

parameters.name: olbl_co2_c1
parameters.description:
OLBL CO2 N2O overlap coefficient $c_1$

unit: W/m^2/sqrt(ppb)

Default: -2.1492e-3

parameters.name: olbl_co2_d1
parameters.description:
OLBL CO2 constant $d_1$

unit: W/m^2

Default: 5.2

parameters.name: olbl_ch4_a3
parameters.description:
OLBL CH4 self-overlap coefficient $a_3$

unit: W/m^2/sqrt(ppb)

Default: -8.9603e-5

parameters.name: olbl_ch4_b3
parameters.description:
OLBL CH4 N2O overlap coefficient $b_3$

unit: W/m^2/sqrt(ppb)

Default: -1.2462e-4

parameters.name: olbl_ch4_d3
parameters.description:
OLBL CH4 constant $d_3$

unit: W/m^2

Default: 0.045

parameters.name: olbl_n2o_a2
parameters.description:
OLBL N2O CO2 overlap coefficient $a_2$

unit: W/m^2/sqrt(ppm)

Default: -3.4197e-4

parameters.name: olbl_n2o_b2
parameters.description:
OLBL N2O self-overlap coefficient $b_2$

unit: W/m^2/sqrt(ppb)

Default: 2.5455e-4

parameters.name: olbl_n2o_c2
parameters.description:
OLBL N2O CH4 overlap coefficient $c_2$

unit: W/m^2/sqrt(ppb)

Default: -2.4357e-4

parameters.name: olbl_n2o_d2
parameters.description:
OLBL N2O constant $d_2$

unit: W/m^2

Default: 0.14

parameters.name: adjust_co2
parameters.description:
Rapid adjustment factor that converts instantaneous CO2 forcing to ERF

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: adjust_ch4
parameters.description:
Rapid adjustment factor that converts instantaneous CH4 forcing to ERF.

unit: dimensionless

Below 1 because CH4 has a negative tropospheric adjustment.

Default: 0.86 (CH4 has negative tropospheric adjustment)

parameters.name: adjust_n2o
parameters.description:
Rapid adjustment factor that converts instantaneous N2O forcing to ERF.

unit: dimensionless

MAGICC7 v7.5.3 applies no adjustment.

Default: 1.0 (no adjustment in MAGICC7 v7.5.3)

parameters.name: ch4_stratospheric_h2o_fraction
parameters.description:
Stratospheric H2O ERF from CH4 oxidation as a fraction of CH4 ERF at pre-industrial N2O
(MAGICC7 `CH4_ADDEDSTRATH2O_PERCENT`)

unit: dimensionless
